hypothesis: The complete paired VGNC trace can be joined to the admitted baseline graph-stage trace to identify which baseline edge and partition states characterize rescued, lost, and still-missed reference pairs. This will prioritize a general-property-based candidate-construction mechanism without rerunning or relabeling the baseline graph as a variant graph.
cohort: All 23934 asserted VGNC rows, with unchanged labels, native aliases, HMM-hit evidence, and both within-species assertions. No selection by observed graph support.
inputs: qfo_graph_stage_readback_20261013.json and its pinned graph-stage table
gates: Require completed independently read-back producer statuses, immutable receipt/report/table/plan hashes, and the same original control-table identity.
Require every graph-stage row to reproduce every control-table field exactly and pair immutable control-to-variant fields exactly, preserving row order and the full cohort.
Validate canonical unique pairs, boolean graph/partition columns, finite positive present-edge weights and explicit NA absent-edge weights.
Reproduce native TP/FN counts, rescue/loss counts, and both unchanged within-species assertions from the admitted paired trace.
Execute tested frozen source, bind actual source and input bytes before and after diagnosis, and refuse existing output namespaces.
observations: baseline graph-edge presence by TP/FN transition
baseline partition co-membership and boundaries by TP/FN transition
baseline graph and partition context of each final variant stage
initial directed HMM-hit counts in each descriptive stratum
selection_rule: No parameter selection, new inference, or default promotion. Join all rows and summarize prespecified strata. Finish current fresh-search and copy-branch rounds before selecting a new bounded mechanism experiment.
limitations: All graph and intermediate partition fields are BASELINE context, not execution states of the deferral variant. No causal attribution to a variant stage is justified by this join.

Stage traces inherit their previously verified native graph/checkpoint audits; this diagnostic rechecks consumed receipts, tables, plans, and executed sources, not every transitive array or native prediction file.
Reference-exposed descriptive diagnosis is not independent validation; graph connectivity and functional similarity are not orthology truth.
Rows contribute to both transition and variant-outcome summaries; these are separate views of the same cohort, not independent observations.
Reference assertions can share genes and labels; no independent-family uncertainty is claimed.
Shared-host diagnostic resource observations are not full-pipeline inference timings.

Linux post-exec VmHWM is used for the diagnostic memory budget. Preserve getrusage maxrss separately because the current launcher can carry a much larger pre-exec high-water mark; do not interpret it as attributable diagnostic RSS.
